cds.title: West Texas A&M University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF; page footers still read 2024-2025, data are the fall 2025 class)

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 first-years): 7,270 applied, 4,857 admitted (66.8%). 2,447 applicants (621 admitted) have unknown residency, so the in-state and out-of-state rows do not add up to the totals; international 28 of 30 admitted, 9 enrolled. Enrolled 1,197 is the full-time plus part-time count (by status and by residency); the rows by sex add up to 1,165. 554 students (46%) sent SAT scores and 370 (31%) sent ACT scores. No waitlist, no early decision or early action; priority and closing date 8/1 for domestic applicants. The GPA breakdown is filled in only for students who sent scores, so it is not shown; the average GPA of 3.61 covers all reporting students. Class rank: top tenth 16%, top quarter 42%. Undergraduate enrollment is 7,110 (total undergraduates); the nonresident undergraduate count could not be read from the Common Data Set tables, so it is not shown. The student-faculty ratio is 15:1.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'. SAT, ACT, AP, CLEP and TSI are used for placement.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (2026-27): in-state tuition $6,672, nonresident tuition $21,837, required fees $2,992, on-campus food and housing $11,101 (housing $5,995 + meal plan $4,150). Estimated expenses: books $1,600, transportation $2,894, other $2,004 (transportation and other together make up other costs). Per-credit-hour: $207 resident, $688 nonresident. The college did not report the nonresident aid items in the Common Data Set, so no international aid counts are shown
